summary: Completed full codebase audit of DeepSlop, validated 23 firmwares, audited 12 payloads, verified hosting tools and SPRX linkage database.
Completed deep vulnerability and architectural research on PS5 web-connected libraries (libSceXml heap overflow, libSceAvPlayer atom size truncation, sysmodule loading, IPMI daemon IPC).

Completed security architecture audit + interface mapping + attack surface analysis of 26 web-connected PS5 SPRX libs (FW 12.70). Catalogued 1695 exports / 1943 imports incl. 3 priv libs extracted fresh (libSceWebTransport ngtcp2, libSceWtIpcClient, libSceSdma). Differential: 12.00→12.20→12.70 zero semantic changes (no patch candidates); 12.60 excluded (divergent build line, 0/308 W:/Build paths). Verified bounded: WebM EBML reader, WS frame lengths, Sysmodule snprintf paths. Confirmed unpatched: libSceXml entity decode flaw, libSceAvPlayer stts count truncation.
